pending_interview.category: System design (ML/AI-specific) — RAG at scale, eval pipeline design, recommendation systems, agent platforms, feature store design
pending_interview.question: You are designing a real-time personalized recommendation system for a large e-commerce platform with 50 million active users and a catalog of 10 million products. The system must return ranked recommendations in under 100 milliseconds. Walk through your end-to-end architecture: how you generate candidate items, how you rank them, what data you store and where, how you keep recommendations fresh as user behavior and inventory change, and what tradeoffs you are making at each stage.
